subject: Whoa J&As — Oct 21: CBP sole-sources contract attorneys to review body-camera footage for litigation, citing unusual urgency
body:
## 1. CBP sole-sources contract attorneys to review body-camera footage for litigation, citing unusual urgency

**US CUSTOMS AND BORDER PROTECTION (HOMELAND SECURITY, DEPARTMENT OF) · Contact Government Services, LLC (CGS) · GSAR 538.7104-3(b)(1)(i)**  
*Posted 2026-10-20, award 70B04C26F00001107, “Legal Staffing Support and eDiscovery Services”*

CBP proposes an order to Contact Government Services under an unusual-urgency authority for document review in litigation. The document says a rise in discovery and litigation demands has strained its Office of Chief Counsel's resources, and failing court deadlines can lead to monetary sanctions.

> “CBP has experienced an unanticipated and unexpected rise in discovery and litigation demands that have strained OCC’s resources and ability to meet operational demands in a timely fashion.”  
> — SSJ_Legal_Staffing_Final_Redacted.pdf, p. 2

> “Failing to meet these deadlines can lead to dire consequences, including monetary sanctions against the Agency and adverse decisions.”  
> — SSJ_Legal_Staffing_Final_Redacted.pdf, p. 2

[SAM.gov notice](https://sam.gov/opp/f276ee9684e447dfb175747512c6f568/view) · [SSJ_Legal_Staffing_Final_Redacted.pdf](https://huggingface.co/datasets/abigailhaddad/federal-ja-documents/resolve/e93882dcc18c1d76244974093b3696fd5e5e016e/files/f276ee9684e447dfb175747512c6f568/9d03811abcad4f25bf6dcf41a2921b4a_SSJ_Legal_Staffing_Final_Redacted.pdf)

## 2. ICE extends detainee medical claims contract with Acentra after VA abruptly ended the support

**US IMMIGRATION AND CUSTOMS ENFORCEMENT (HOMELAND SECURITY, DEPARTMENT OF) · Acentra Health, LLC (Acentra) · 41 U.S.C. §3304 as implemented by RFO 6.103-1**  
*Posted 2026-10-20, award 70CDCR26C00000002, “Medical Claims Support Extension”*

ICE says the VA Financial Services Center ended medical claims processing support on October 3, 2025, creating an emergency. It now proposes adding six option periods, running to 2030, to the sole-source Acentra contract.

> “This support, which was historically provided by the Veteran's Administration (VA) Financial Services Center (VAFSC), was abruptly terminated by the VA on October 3, 2025.”  
> — 5.1.1-P00005_JOFOC_Claims_Redacted.pdf, p. 2 (machine-transcribed page)

[SAM.gov notice](https://sam.gov/opp/e25509e392e44676bfe14bff8e4399cd/view) · [5.1.1-P00005_JOFOC_Claims_Redacted.pdf](https://huggingface.co/datasets/abigailhaddad/federal-ja-documents/resolve/e93882dcc18c1d76244974093b3696fd5e5e016e/files/e25509e392e44676bfe14bff8e4399cd/e3ac2d517409448b9e5ec8aaabf1b1bb_5.1.1-P00005_JOFOC_Claims_Redacted.pdf)

## 3. ICE/HSI plans sole-source wiretap and telecom analysis software with embedded generative AI

**US IMMIGRATION AND CUSTOMS ENFORCEMENT (HOMELAND SECURITY, DEPARTMENT OF) · Pen-Link, Limited · RFO 6.103-1**  
*Posted 2026-10-20, “Notice of Intent to Sole Source - Telecommunications Analysis Software Support”*

HSI intends a sole-source award to Pen-Link for telecommunications analysis software, with one base year and four option years. The requirements include live intercepts, GPS tracking, and a generative AI assistant on ICE-provided Azure accounts.

> “An embedded Generative AI assistant (leveraging ICE/HSI-provided Azure AI accounts) enabling users to search, query, filter, interact with, summarize, map, and visualize”  
> — 1.2.1-NOI High Level Requirements 10.14.2026.pdf, p. 4

[SAM.gov notice](https://sam.gov/opp/37a5b7df3e7b42bfb41b04372277738f/view) · [1.2.1-NOI High Level Requirements 10.14.2026.pdf](https://huggingface.co/datasets/abigailhaddad/federal-ja-documents/resolve/e93882dcc18c1d76244974093b3696fd5e5e016e/files/37a5b7df3e7b42bfb41b04372277738f/8531508496cd4664a6f2f8c539eb06f1_1.2.1-NOI_High_Level_Requirements_10.14.2026.pdf)

## 4. Joint Staff training bridge needed because a new executive order requires Navy approval of the contract type

**DEPT OF THE NAVY (DEPT OF DEFENSE) · Serco, Inc · 10 U.S.C. 3204(a)(1)-(2) as implemented by FAR 6.103-1 and FAR 6.103-2**  
*Posted 2026-10-20, award N0018926CD020, “Collective Joint Training Bridge Contract”*

Navy is sole-sourcing a bridge to Serco because the follow-on non-FFP award must be approved by the Assistant Secretary of the Navy under a rule implementing EO 14402. The document says the time frame for that approval is not known.

> “The exact time frame is not known for approval to be granted and therefore the contracting activity must award a standalone bridge contract to allow for continued contract support.”  
> — Collective Joint Training Bridge JA Redacted.pdf, p. 1

[SAM.gov notice](https://sam.gov/opp/1c2c3295991443d9a8e3c8c9eb274750/view) · [Collective Joint Training Bridge JA Redacted.pdf](https://huggingface.co/datasets/abigailhaddad/federal-ja-documents/resolve/e93882dcc18c1d76244974093b3696fd5e5e016e/files/1c2c3295991443d9a8e3c8c9eb274750/e702c4eb7545414cbf6e3c1dc9f16d6a_Collective_Joint_Training_Bridge_JA_Redacted.pdf)

## 5. NASA sole-sources $11.89M autonomy modules; a correction admits a competitor's response was missed

**NATIONAL AERONAUTICS AND SPACE ADMINISTRATION · EraDrive, Inc. · $11,890,000**  
*Posted 2026-10-20, award 80ARC026C0006, “Justification for Other Than Full and Open Competition: Spacecraft Optical Navigation and Autonomy Modules (Contract 80ARC026C0006)”*

NASA Ames awarded EraDrive a sole-source contract valued at $11,890,000. A later correction says the original statement that no capability statements were received was a scrivener's error, and that one from Rhea Space Activity was evaluated.

> “One capability statement was received, from Rhea Space Activity, Inc., on June 30, 2026, within the response period.”  
> — 80ARC026R0008_JOFOC_Section10_Correction_PUBLIC.pdf, p. 1

> “The estimated value is $11,890,000 and the period of performance is from the date of award through December 31, 2028 (the end of the first quarter of fiscal year (FY) 2029), corresponding to final delivery of the autonomy modules. 3.”  
> — EraDrive_JOFOC_80ARC026R0008_Redacted_for_Posting_9292026.pdf, p. 1 (source of the figure above, quoted by the checks)

[SAM.gov notice](https://sam.gov/opp/86750493376a45dfa7fe2b92b6cc3e5d/view) · [EraDrive_JOFOC_80ARC026R0008_Redacted_for_Posting_9292026.pdf](https://huggingface.co/datasets/abigailhaddad/federal-ja-documents/resolve/e93882dcc18c1d76244974093b3696fd5e5e016e/files/86750493376a45dfa7fe2b92b6cc3e5d/46bbb3bdf4ab41f68b6b443769cb0380_EraDrive_JOFOC_80ARC026R0008_Redacted_for_Posting_9292026.pdf) · [80ARC026R0008_JOFOC_Section10_Correction_PUBLIC.pdf](https://huggingface.co/datasets/abigailhaddad/federal-ja-documents/resolve/e93882dcc18c1d76244974093b3696fd5e5e016e/files/86750493376a45dfa7fe2b92b6cc3e5d/fd405ceb3dcc499682ca84f6492dbea4_80ARC026R0008_JOFOC_Section10_Correction_PUBLIC.pdf)

*What this is:* a daily pick of the most remarkable new federal sole-source justification (J&A) notices posted on SAM.gov, from the public [federal-ja-documents dataset](https://huggingface.co/datasets/abigailhaddad/federal-ja-documents). *How:* the picks and write-ups are AI-selected and AI-written (Claude). Every quote was checked word for word against the notice's document text, and dollar figures come from those quotes or from quote-checked extraction fields. AI can still misread a document: check the source before relying on anything. [How it works](https://github.com/abigailhaddad/federal-ja-documents/blob/main/docs/digest.md).
